sync_estimate.uncertainty_basis: Conservative estimate for displayed OS clock refresh, recording-start timestamp and ASR phase boundaries; not hardware-trigger validation.

phase_definitions.baseline_start: End of initial instruction; start of quiet rest (local ASR estimate).
phase_definitions.dialog_start: Start of first interview question after rest (local ASR estimate).
phase_definitions.dialog_end: End of instruction to sit quietly after interview (local ASR estimate).
phase_definitions.post_end: Unset: video EOF and BioRadio recording stop are different events; do not align their endpoints.

research_notes: Split training and evaluation by participant_id. IDs, labels, source_annotation_ids and timing are not predictive features.
Text and question content can disclose the interview protocol; assess text features separately to avoid target leakage.
dataset_eligible means a reviewed target, not validated physiology. Filter features by sync_status and coverage.
HRV requires at least 120 seconds and sufficient usable beats. Short answers retain missing HRV.
Primary rPPG only uses windows fully inside the answer; context rPPG is deliberately excluded.
GSR=100000 throughout the interval is unavailable. Channel coverage counts finite usable samples, not detector accuracy.
Pauses may be incompletely annotated. Full answer duration always includes elapsed internal silence.
Values are unrounded and not normalized to baseline. Baseline intervals and markers are in this metadata.

compatibility_export.method: Select and order the 87 schema-1 columns. Only dataset_schema_version changed; all other retained cell values, rows and labels are identical. Calculation version remains 2. Notes may retain observations about omitted phase features.
